chronology.RN: Sussex joins Illustrious/Gambia in the afternoon. Gambia then detaches for Fremantle. Nizam and Quality depart Trincomalee to reinforce the returning carrier screen.
chronology.Japan: No weapon-quality cue. 705 discretionary long-range search is already constrained by redeployment preparation.

chronology.RN: Nizam and Quality join Illustrious around 1500FG while the carrier returns toward Ceylon. Separately, Renown/Queen Elizabeth/Ceylon put to sea for exercises but return after a reported submarine periscope in the practice area.
chronology.Japan: No surface or air force receives a correlated Illustrious track.

chronology.RN: Gambia reaches Fremantle. Available fleet destroyers conduct a submarine hunt southwest of Ceylon after the previous warning.
chronology.submarine_identity: I-162 is geographically plausible as one candidate while outbound toward the Maldive/77E route, but identification is NOT established and no Branch weapon contact is credited.

chronology.RN: Illustrious returns to Trincomalee with Napier, Nizam, Quality and Quickmatch in the arriving screen. Sussex does not accompany her into Trincomalee and continues on its separate return toward Fremantle.

outcome.operational_value: search mission fails to find target but provides carrier/ASW/work-up sea time and demonstrates continuing destroyer scarcity around the battle squadron
